duplicatedCoreModules.reason: Question selection and scoring are calculated on demand; active sessions live in the shared database, not a module cache.
Conjugation explanations are derived from static verb-pair hints; the module keeps no user-data cache.
The class definition can be duplicated; audio-pack-platform.weapp stores its sole live instance on globalThis for all route bundles.
Weekly metrics are calculated from query results on demand; no user records are cached in the module.

The account import page and lazy sync replay use the same deterministic parser/materializer; all writes and cache invalidation go through the shared database and main-package word-library singleton, with no module-local user state.
The lazy setup panel and account/study plan pages calculate from the shared database and persisted preferences on every call; baseline values live in localStorage, not a module cache.

Each isolated route package mounts only its own study source; partial baseline windows are persisted on page exit, countdown state is deliberately discarded, and rewards are guarded by unique database ledger keys.
globalThis.__shushugoAudioPackClient is shared by every subpackage; only that instance owns the wx file ledger and transfer queue.
Reports are read from and written to the shared database on each call; the module keeps no report snapshot.
The canvas and file sequence are temporary rendering state scoped to a page bundle, not persisted user data.
Dictionary matches are computed from the supplied database rows; results are not retained in a module cache.
All catalog/cache/transfer state belongs to the process-wide client. Preferences and voice ownership are read live; plan arrays are not retained.

The lazy post-login callback and independent account routes read account-keyed pending flags and avatar signatures from shared Preferences on every call; this module retains no session, profile or retry queue in memory.
Study rows and account-keyed caches are read from SQLite/localStorage on each call; only request coalescing is module-local, and duplicate route requests merge activity idempotently on the Worker.
The lazy auth dialog and account legal pages read the same immutable bundled policy text; consent-version constants remain shared in legal-versions.ts and no consent state is stored here.
Share and save operations use the image passed to each call and retain no mutable user state.
The lazy setup panel and study plan route query current database progress and persisted preferences; this module retains no user data.
SAP1 encoding/catalog validation are pure functions; there is no module-level cache.
Only public voice-index content and package-local audio handles are cached; user preferences are read live and no study data is cached.
Question groups and results are derived from the shared database on demand; there is no module-level user-data cache.
The WeakSet records only an idempotent legacy-migration marker per DB object; position values remain in the shared database.
Reading normalization and audio hashes are pure functions with no user state.
Team periods, check-in eligibility, and duel scores are pure calculations over supplied values; the module keeps no mutable state.
Setup previews and plan routes share deterministic matrices over bundled content counts; user input and preview results are passed to each call and never cached.
Timer state and intervals belong to each mounted React hook instance; no shared module state is retained.
Timer state is passed immutably between calls and belongs to the mounted page, not a module singleton.
Grammar form matching is a pure calculation over the supplied grammar point.
Share cards are stored on the native page instance, not in module state, so the main-package and lazy copies see the same card.
Memoized values are deterministic lookups over bundled title-furigana content, not user data.
The lazy auth dialog and account legal pages read immutable agreement text; consent records and version constants are not cached in this content module.
Plan load estimates are pure calculations over supplied quotas and fixed age coefficients, with no module-local user state.
The module reads bundled grammar key-point content and retains no mutable user state.
Study totals are queried from the shared database on demand; query results are not cached.
Ordinal maps are derived only from bundled grammar records and are safe package-local content caches.
Haptics call the Mini Program vibration API per invocation and keep no module state.
Setup completion uses shared database, preferences and progress events on each call; the module owns no session state.
The helper schedules a paint yield and retains no state.
Notes are read from and written to app-wide localStorage on every call; this module has no in-memory note cache.
Only immutable event-name constants are duplicated; event dispatch/listeners belong to the shared TaroWindow.
